purpose: Public-source gap analysis for index valuation monthly PE/PB database

findings.metric: NASDAQ 100 trailing PE and related ratios
findings.public_history: ten year-end values 2016-2025 plus latest month
findings.free_tier_limitation: subset of tickers and handful of period-end snapshots; complete history and full index coverage are paid
findings.method: aggregate index market capitalization / aggregate normalized trailing net income
findings.decision: Do not import annual rows or sparse free-tier snapshots as a monthly series.

findings.method: aggregate market capitalization / aggregate shareholders equity; negative book equity constituents excluded; point-in-time index membership
findings.decision: Archive as candidate source observations; insufficient monthly coverage for rolling 5Y/10Y percentile.

findings.public_access: month-end constituent performance report download entry; wider data points to Index360 registration
findings.decision: No continuous auditable monthly PE/PB raw values verified; do not estimate.

data_policy: Keep public annual and sparse monthly candidate observations outside the unified monthly matrix until continuous 60/120-month observations are verified. Never interpolate or forward-fill.
